outcome: differences between rectal and axillary temperature measurements
cohort: Eighty preterm infants born less than 32 weeks' gestation were included upon their admission to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU).
finding: Rectal and axillary temperatures showed a strong correlation (0.915), but the wide limits of agreement (+0.7 to -0.6 degC) indicated variability, particularly in hypothermic infants.
cross-section timing: upon admission to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
